databaseRelease.restoreDrill: profile-safety focal restore passed with ugc_reports=16 and chat_profile_blocks=2

notes: Production had drifted to broad anon/authenticated table privileges and anonymous EXECUTE on the three profile-safety RPCs even though the original moderation migration intended authenticated RPC-only mutation.

The successor revokes anonymous RPC execution, preserves authenticated RPC execution, denies direct report/block table mutation to untrusted roles, preserves authenticated RLS-filtered reads and removes direct sequence use.

The production probe used two temporary active profiles inside one transaction. Anonymous calls, actor spoofing and self-targeting were rejected; a spoofed unblock preserved the foreign edge, while the bound actor could report, block and unblock the peer; the transaction was rolled back and residue was zero.

This unit closes the backend permission-negative boundary for profile report/block/unblock. It does not claim hosted Auth/API gateway/Realtime availability, UI report-failure acceptance or unrelated profile races.
